summary: PR-1971 introduces a new applicant field 'coapplicant_tax_id' (a government tax identifier, i.e. NPI under ENC-1) but does not register it in the NpiRegistry or in the approved npi_fields list in policy-params.json. The Retention.purge() code handles this field in a separate line outside the NpiRegistry.FIELDS loop, confirming it is not part of the encryption-at-rest domain. The ENC-1 control test is exhaustive only over the npi_registry and would not detect the unregistered field, so the new tax identifier would be persisted in plaintext. This is a direct violation of ENC-1. All process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-7, EXC-1, LAP-1) are satisfied, and RET-1 is shown because the field is explicitly included in the purge logic. However, the unencrypted storage of a tax identifier is a critical control failure, so the change must be rejected and reworked to register the field in the NPI registry before it can be accepted.
